title: 第五章 虎芸
content_zh:
时间过的很快,转瞬间便是一天过去了。

    从妖兽之林中,已经有不下一千人被淘汰掉了。多是一些无法斩杀妖兽,或是被妖兽差点吃掉的。而江尘却一整天都是十分兴奋一般,简直就是一尊杀神,短短一天的时间里面,已经有不下百头妖兽命丧他手。

    一处树木茂盛的峡谷内,江尘正干净利落的将最后一只妖兽剥皮、拆骨,找到了一颗红色的妖丹。

    “啧啧,今天的收获真是不小,九十五头一星低阶妖兽,加上五头一星中阶妖兽,江尘的功勋点已经有一百四十五点了。只是这排名却是低了点,才一万两千三百五十一位,看来要想办法猎杀一些等级高点的妖兽了。”江尘仔细盘算道。

    妖兽按照实力强弱划分为一星到九星共九个等级。其中七星以上便能被成为妖王,而九星妖兽实力则与人族九星星皇相差无几故而称之为妖皇。

    江尘仔细看过玉牌上关于妖兽之林的介绍,这是一处秘境,乃是上古一位大能者开辟出的试练之所,无比广大。而里面大多数都是一些一星、二星的妖兽,也有一些三星妖兽,不过在其深处,据说也有妖王级别的存在。

    按照一般规律,星者能够对抗一星妖兽,而星师则能对抗二星、三星的妖兽,甚至可以对抗四星中阶的妖兽。

    星者也就是能够初步掌握星力,施展星技的人。而星师对星力的掌握力变得更好,所施展出的星技威力也就更大。

    江尘目前的实力在三星星师巅峰,对付寻常的一星、二星妖兽甚至是三星低阶妖兽都是手到擒来。之所以到目前为止,没有多少功勋点,是因为他一直都在试探,并未太急于向深处而去。

    收好那颗红色的妖丹,望着已经逐渐暗下来的天,江尘却并未打算休息。而是趁着夜色,扛起一大块妖兽肉,全速向深处掠去。江尘的速度极快,身形却像极了一只翱翔天际的青鸾。这正是老道士传授给江尘的身法星技,名叫青鸾步。

    江尘三岁开始修行,到现在不过是九年的时间。可偏偏就是这九年的时间,江尘的青鸾步,已经修炼到第一层大圆满了。

    足足两个时辰,江尘这才停了下来。仔细观察了周围,江尘这才放松开来。找到了一处石壁下方的空隙,江尘捡了一些柴火,生起了一堆火。这才将那块妖兽肉用树枝穿好,很是悠闲的烤起肉来。

    过了一阵,肉香四溢,伴随着肉本身发出的“滋滋”声,让江尘也是忍不住咽了咽口水。正准备一口咬下去的时候,江尘猛地感觉到,在不远处的草丛中,有一双眼睛正在盯着他。
content_en:
Time passed quickly, and one day passed in an instant.

    From the forest of monsters, no less than a thousand people have been eliminated. Most of them were those that could not kill the monsters, or were almost eaten by the monsters. Jiang Chen, on the other hand, had been very excited all day, he was like a god of murder. In just one day, no less than a hundred monster beasts had been killed by him.

    In a canyon with lush trees, Jiang Chen was neatly peeling off the skin and bones of the last demon beast and found a red demon pill.

    "Tsk tsk, today's harvest is really not small. Ninety-five one-star low-level monsters, plus five one-star mid-level monsters, Jiang Chen's merit points are already 145 points. But this ranking is a bit lower, only 12,351. It seems that he has to find a way to hunt down some higher-level monsters." Jiang Chen carefully calculated.

    Monsters are divided into nine levels from one star to nine stars according to their strength. Among them, those with seven stars and above can be called demon kings, while the strength of nine-star demon beasts is almost the same as that of the human nine-star emperor, so they are called demon kings.

    Jiang Chen carefully read the introduction about the Forest of Demonic Beasts on the jade plaque. This is a secret realm, a trial place opened by a powerful person in ancient times. It is extremely vast. Most of them are one-star and two-star monsters, and there are also some three-star monsters, but in its depths, it is said that there are also demon king-level existences.

    According to general rules, Star Masters can fight against one-star monsters, while Star Masters can fight against two-star, three-star monsters, and even four-star mid-level monsters.

    Star users are people who can initially master star power and perform star skills. As the star master's control over star power becomes better, the power of the star skills displayed becomes greater.

    Jiang Chen's current strength is at the peak of a three-star master, and he can easily deal with ordinary one-star, two-star monsters and even low-level three-star monsters. The reason why there are not many merit points so far is because he has been testing and not too eager to go deeper.

    After putting away the red demon pill and looking at the gradually darkening sky, Jiang Chen had no intention of taking a rest. Instead, he took advantage of the darkness, picked up a large piece of monster meat, and swept deep into the depths at full speed. Jiang Chen's speed was extremely fast, but his figure looked like a blue luan soaring in the sky. This is exactly the movement and star technique taught to Jiang Chen by the old Taoist priest, called Qingluan Step.

    Jiang Chen started practicing at the age of three, and it has only been nine years now. But it just happened that in these nine years, Jiang Chen's Qingluan Step had reached the first level of Dzogchen.

    After two full hours, Jiang Chen stopped. After carefully observing his surroundings, Jiang Chen relaxed. After finding a gap under the stone wall, Jiang Chen picked up some firewood and lit a fire. Then he tied the piece of monster meat with branches and grilled the meat leisurely.

    After a while, the aroma of meat overflowed, and along with the "sizzling" sound made by the meat itself, Jiang Chen couldn't help but swallow his saliva. Just as he was about to take a bite, Jiang Chen suddenly felt that there was a pair of eyes staring at him in the grass not far away.
